##### Project general facts

MAG City Townhouses by MAG is a gated residential community offering 2-bedroom, 3-bedroom, and 4-bedroom townhouses. The project is designed around nature, community, and security, providing residents with a quiet and relaxed lifestyle while keeping leisure and entertainment close at hand. Each townhouse reflects the developer's focus on contemporary design, high-end finishing and precise attention to detail.

The community is planned to include a nursery, a clubhouse, restaurants and bars, as well as a dedicated retail area and a healthcare clinic. As a safe gated development, it promotes a healthy modern lifestyle and offers everyday convenience within walking distance of home.

Interiors feature 600x600 mm porcelain floor tiles and walls and ceilings finished in washable matt paint. Bathrooms include Armani Grey polished marble vanity tops, Marfil porcelain tiles, glass-enclosed showers and wall-mounted WCs with concealed tanks. Kitchens come with bespoke fitted cabinetry in a wood veneer finish, polished Virgo stone worktops, a stainless steel sink and LED down-lighting. The townhouses are delivered with bespoke built-in wardrobes in a matching veneer finish.

##### Location description and benefits

The project is located in Mohammed bin Rashid City within Meydan, a prestigious district known for the famous Meydan Racecourse. The area is set away from the city's noise while remaining just a few minutes from central Dubai.

Multiple access routes and major highways connect the community to Dubai's key business, entertainment and leisure destinations. This makes daily commuting convenient for working professionals and provides easy access to everything the city has to offer.

The community offers views of Meydan to the east and the Dubai skyline with the iconic Burj Khalifa to the north. The combination of a calm residential atmosphere and a central location makes the area attractive for families and investors.
